elaine: Last sync before content freeze. Need final hero lines and where demo/webinar leads land. Keep it short so design can lock hero tonight.

ana: Draft 3 quick, outcome-focused options per page. 6 words max each.

ana: Hosted: "Launch fast, scale without surprises"
ana: Dedicated: "Predictable performance for business-critical flows"
ana: Private: "Data residency, audit logs, on-prem speed"

mike: Love the tone. Can we make Dedicated more visceral: add the word "latency"?

ana: Updated Dedicated: "Budgeted throughput, reliable latency for apps"

jordan: For hero subheads avoid numeric ms claims. Use: "latency-optimized for production."

elaine: OK. Hero CTAs: Hosted primary "Start free trial" secondary "Watch launch webinar". Dedicated primary "Request capacity demo" secondary same webinar CTA. Private primary "Book private demo".

mike: Routing plan: Hosted -> self-serve flow (product), Dedicated & Private -> SDR queue (enterprise). Webinar signups -> nurture list.

luis: I'll add hidden fields and GTM: 
<form>
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_source" value="hosted">
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_path" value="selfserve|enterprise|webinar">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="tri_mode_launch_2023">
</form>

luis: GTM events: `tri_mode_cta_click` label=page_type, `tri_mode_form_submit` label=lead_path. Will push tags to /product-analytics.

ana: For copy on the webinar CTA, contextualize by page: Hosted -> "Watch: quickstart + cost tips"; Dedicated -> "Watch: throughput & capacity patterns"; Private -> "Watch: security & deployment checklist".

jordan: Webinar plan: 35 minutes total (20 product/demo, 10 benchmarks & methodology, 5 Q&A). Need 1 slide for methodology stating dataset, avg seq len, model family, and a clear callout: "Results will vary by model & workload."

elaine: Deliverables: Ana final copy by 17:00 PT, Luis tracking + hidden fields by 16:00 PT, Jordan slides draft by EOD, Mike launch post draft by tomorrow 09:00.

deploy-bot: Reminder: content freeze at 2023-11-15T18:00:00Z.
